patterns.message: Icons are consolidated on HugeIcons (W3.8). Import from '@/components/icons', or add the icon there / use '@hugeicons/react' directly.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Hardcoded brand hex #FE2C55 is banned (W3.9/W5.1) — use var(--brand) or the brand/instaRed token so a rebrand stays a one-token change.
Arbitrary font size (text-[Npx]) is banned — use a type-scale token (display/h1/h2/body-lg/body/body-sm/caption/micro).
Arbitrary font weight (font-[N]) is banned — use font-normal/medium/semibold/bold.
Arbitrary radius (rounded-[Npx]) is banned — use rounded-field/card/pill or a Tailwind-named radius (rounded, -lg, -xl, -2xl, -3xl).
Hardcoded brand hex #FE2C55 is banned — use var(--brand)/instaRed token.
Arbitrary font size (text-[Npx]) — use a type-scale token.
Arbitrary radius (rounded-[Npx]) — use rounded-field/card/pill or a Tailwind-named radius.
